NONE: A1 a male child or, more generally, a male of any age
男孩；小夥子；男人，男子
› used to express excitement, worry, disappointment, etc. or to emphasize something
（表示興奮或強調）呵，好傢夥！
› a group of male friends
男性朋友們
› also our boys an approving way of speaking about your country's soldiers
（對本國士兵的暱稱）子弟兵，士兵們
› a typical male
典型的男人

example: a teenage/adolescent boy
十幾歲的男孩
As a young boy, my father used to walk three miles to school.
我爸爸小時候常常要走三英里路去上學。
You've been a very naughty boy!
你真是個調皮的男孩！
Their little boy (= their young son) is very sick.
他們的小兒子病得很重。
All right, boys and girls, settle down!
好了，孩子們，安靜下來！
He used to like spending Friday nights with the boys.
他以前週五晚上喜歡與哥們兒在一起。
We must not forget our boys serving far from home.
我們不應該忘記那些遠離家鄉在外服役的子弟兵們。
He plays baseball, drinks a lot of beer and generally acts like one of the boys.
他踢足球，喝啤酒，總的來説是典型的男人作為。
Boy, that was good!
好傢夥，那可真棒！

NONE: › a pop music group made up of young men who sing and dance
男孩樂團（指由男孩組成的流行樂隊）
› a member of the Scouts
童子軍
› an attractive young man, especially one who has relationships with older, powerful, or successful people
（尤指被年長有權勢的人或成功人士包養的）性感男孩，小白臉

example: See also
toy boy

NONE: › a young man who has achieved more than what is expected for his age
神童
› relating to a story, book, or film whose main subject is romantic relationships
（故事、書、電影）以愛情為主題的

example: It was the usual boy-meets-girl sort of movie.
那是一部老套的愛情電影。

NONE: › to refuse to buy a product or take part in an activity as a way of expressing strong disapproval
拒絶購買（或參加）；抵制，杯葛

example: People were urged to boycott the country's products.
人們被鼓動起來杯葛那個國家的産品。
The union called on its members to boycott the meeting.
工會號召其成員拒絶參加會議。

NONE: A2 a man or boy that a person is having a romantic or sexual relationship with
男朋友；（男性）情人
› used to refer to a loose, comfortable style of clothing for women that is based on men's clothes
（女裝）模仿男裝裁剪的，寬鬆舒適的

example: He's not my boyfriend - we're just good friends!
他不是我的男友——我們只是好朋友！
Cathy's ex-boyfriend was a really nice guy.
凱茜的前任男友是個非常好的小夥子。
Compare
girlfriend
a boyfriend jacket/blazer
式樣寬鬆的上裝

NONE: › the period when a person is a boy, and not yet a man, or the state of being a boy
（男子的）孩童時期，少年時代

example: I had a very happy boyhood.
我少年時代過得很開心。
The transition from boyhood to manhood can be a confusing period.
從少年時期過渡到成年時期可能會是個令人困惑的階段。
It was his boyhood ambition/dream to become a film director.
當電影導演是他兒時的志向／夢想。
James Bond was a boyhood hero of mine.
詹姆士．龐德是我少年時心目中的英雄。
See also
childhood

NONE: › used to describe behaviour or characteristics that are like those of a boy
男孩似的

example: a boyish grin
男孩子氣的一笑
She had her hair cut in a boyish style.
她剪了個男孩的髮型。
Even as an old man he retained his boyish charm.
即使老了，他依然保留著那份童真。
She found his boyish good looks very attractive.
她覺得他那孩子氣的漂亮外表很迷人。

NONE: › said to emphasize that people should not be surprised when boys or men act in a rough or noisy way because this is part of the male character
男孩子就是這様；男人總歸是男人
